summary: Verified NEW module 'Kas Operasional' (Cash Book) — both backend (26/26 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_cashbook.py) and frontend UI (all flows on /cashbook). Backend covers: (1) Chart of Accounts CRUD with 20 default accounts seeded on first read (4 income 301-304, 16 expense 201/401-403/501-512/599, system flag correctly set on 301 & 201); duplicate-code 400; invalid type 400; system account code immutable (400); system account delete 400. (2) Settings GET auto-init + PUT persistence. (3) Manual transactions POST (type derived from account), amount<=0 → 400, empty description → 400, invalid account 404. (4) Running balance in GET /cashbook/transactions?month=YYYY-MM (verified prev_balance +/- amount = tx.balance for every row). (5) Auto-tx protections: PUT/DELETE on auto=true tx return 400. (6) GET /cashbook/balance formula (opening+in-out). (7) GET /cashbook/summary structure (period_start/end, breakdown_in/out lists). (8) Excel export returns valid xlsx (PK signature) with correct Content-Type & Content-Disposition attachment. (9) INTEGRATION 1: POST /api/sales creates auto cash tx with account_code=301, type=in, reference=sale_no, auto=true, amount=total. (10) INTEGRATION 2: DELETE /api/sales cascades — matching auto tx (reference=sale_no, account_code=301) is removed. (11) INTEGRATION 3: PUT /api/purchasing/purchase-orders/{id}/pay creates auto cash tx with account_code=201, type=out, reference=po_no, auto=true, amount=payment. (12) Regression: Sales list + Purchasing list still return full docs incl. payment_status. FRONTEND: Sidebar 'Kas Operasional' (nav-cashbook, Wallet icon) present for super_admin; /cashbook route renders header + 4 stat cards (stat-balance/stat-in-month/stat-out-month/stat-closing-month) + 2 tabs (tab-book/tab-summary) + month filter + search; PEMASUKAN modal shows only income accounts (301-304 verified), PENGELUARAN modal shows only expense accounts (17 codes: 201/401-403/501-512/599 verified); manual pengeluaran creation → tx appears in table with search filter working; Setting modal opens with setting-date & setting-balance; Accounts modal shows 25 rows with 2 SYSTEM badges (301 & 201) and add-account-button opens sub-form with acc-code/acc-name/acc-type/save-account-button; Summary tab renders breakdown. Auto tx from backend PO test showed correct visual treatment: amber row background + 'AUTO' badge with lock icon + edit/delete buttons rendered but disabled (screenshot confirms).

issues: Row action buttons (edit/delete) for auto-tx use opacity-30 + cursor-not-allowed but no aria-disabled or visible tooltip beyond title attr. Users may still try clicking. Consider stronger visual (grayscale filter or bg-zinc-100).
Close 'X' button in modal header has no data-testid. Not blocking but inconsistent with other close-tx-modal testid.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 5277 lines — cashbook module (~460 lines) is the 4th sub-module bolted on this file. Splitting into /app/backend/routers/cashbook.py should be planned. Continuing accumulation is a maintenance risk.

Cash export endpoint (/cashbook/export) internally calls cash_transactions_list(user=user, month=month) — this is a good pattern but note: passing `user` dict directly (bypassing Depends) works only because require_super_admin already ran on the caller. Any refactor that changes the signature will silently break. Consider extracting a pure helper function that both endpoints call.

Auto-insert hooks in sales_create and po_pay swallow all exceptions with logger.warning — if MongoDB temporarily fails on the cash insert, the Sale/PO still succeeds but the cash book will be out of sync. Consider retry-on-insert or at least writing a compensation record to a 'failed_cash_inserts' collection for later reconciliation.

delete_many on sale cascade (line 4670) matches reference+auto+account_code=301. If a user manually created a cash tx with the SAME reference as an existing sale_no (unlikely but possible since manual auto flag is false), the auto=True filter protects them — correct. Good defensive query.
CashTransactionIn model has no field length limits — a 10MB description string would be accepted. Add Field(max_length=500) on description to prevent abuse.

cash_transactions_list uses in-memory sort + running balance calc — fine up to 20000 tx (declared limit) but no pagination. When user has >20000 lifetime txs, list truncates silently. Add total_count response field or refuse the query with a clear message.
Frontend CashBook.jsx uses window.confirm — same pattern as rest of app but confirm dialogs are not styled. Consider a shared Confirm component using shadcn AlertDialog for consistency.
Frontend has no error boundary around CashBook; if API returns unexpected shape (e.g. txData.transactions is null), filter() line 56 crashes. Add optional chaining or default `[]`.
Auto-tx protection in UI uses disabled attribute on button — good. But the underlying handler onRemove already double-checks `if (t.auto)` — good defense-in-depth.

The 'Kategori Akun' modal shows a nested modal (form modal) opened on top of the accounts list modal — z-index handled (z-50 → z-[60]) but on mobile the sub-form modal's cancel button close only the sub-form, then user must dismiss outer modal. Two-step close UX. Acceptable but could be flattened.

IN/OUT dropdown in TxModal filters by account.type only — does NOT filter out inactive accounts. If admin sets an income account to inactive, it still appears in the PEMASUKAN dropdown. Minor bug — consider filtering with a.active !== false.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 13 data-testids present; nav + stat cards + 2 tabs + PEMASUKAN modal + PENGELUARAN modal + Setting modal + Accounts modal + Add-account sub-form + Summary breakdown + auto-tx AUTO badge all verified)
